subject: Post-call: Thermafuse integration scope, SDK function-calls & POC roadmap
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya@thermafuse.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Thermafuse integration scope, SDK function-calls & POC roadmap

Hi Priya — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Key pain points you shared
- Current triage & search returns too many false positives; CS spends ~40% of time surface-sifting.
- Latency spikes during peak hours — target is p95 < 600ms for interactive triage flows.
- Hard to maintain structured case fields across agent responses (we need reliable JSON output).
- Cost sensitivity on high-volume rerank/embedding calls.

Primary goals
1) Replace current keyword-based search with embeddings + lightweight rerank to cut manual triage by ~30–40%.
2) Deliver a streaming assistant that can call your case-management APIs (create/update) via function-calls to automate field population.
3) Produce deterministic structured outputs (strict JSON schema) for downstream analytics and audit.

Technical fit & constraints we discussed
- You want streaming responses (partial tokens) for better UX and to show live suggestions.
- Function-calls must be idempotent and return a small JSON payload with case_id, status, priority.
- Embedding index will be on your side (S3 + vector DB) but we'll run similarity scoring and rerank in-host.
- Token cost sensitivity — explore quantized model variants + prefix cache for common prompts.

Proposed POC (6 weeks) — high level
- Week 0–1: Sample data transfer (you share ~5k anonymized cases + schema), alignment on JSON schema and SLOs.
- Week 2: Redwood provides a demo POC: streaming chat + function-calls integration to a sandbox case API.
- Week 3–4: Embed + rerank integration, measure recall/precision and latency at p50/p95.
- Week 5–6: Iterate on prompts, quantization profile, and cost vs quality trade-offs; hand-off plan for production rollout.

Immediate asks from Thermafuse
- Share a small representative dataset (5k rows) and your desired JSON schema for case fields. Prefer S3 link or a CSV/JSON attachment.
- Confirm priority of features (streaming vs synchronous rerank) so we can scope resources.

Next meeting
- Can we schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive with Samir (eng), Vivek (solutions), and Aditya (runtime) next week? Laura (me) will lead the kickoff.

Attachments: Thermafuse_Redwood_POA.pdf (high-level plan), thermafuse_sample_payloads.json (example payloads)

Thanks — I’ll circulate a calendar invite once you confirm availability.

—
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Priya Desai <priya@thermafuse.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@thermafuse.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Thermafuse integration scope, SDK function-calls & POC roadmap

Laura — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with our internal view. A few quick clarifications: 

- We can share an anonymized S3 dump of ~5k cases by EOD Friday (I’ll send access to s3://thermafuse-samples).
- Streaming + function-calls are both high priority — if we must sequence, prioritize streaming UX first, then optimize rerank.
- For function-calls: Samir will own the sandbox API and the idempotency window; he prefers the function signature to accept a minimal JSON and return the updated case object.
- Timeline: we’re targeting a Q2 pilot; a 6-week POC looks reasonable if we start mid-February.

Samir — looping you in for schema + API questions. Please confirm the fields we want populated automatically (proposed: case_id, summary, priority, product_tag, sla_deadline).

Thanks — Priya
Priya Desai
Head of Product | Thermafuse Labs
priya@thermafuse.com | +1 (650) 555-2647

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@thermafuse.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@thermafuse.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Thermafuse integration scope, SDK function-calls & POC roadmap

Vivek, Aditya — forwarding Priya’s confirmation. Action items below for us to own before the technical kickoff: 

1) Vivek: can you draft an SDK sample (node + python) that demonstrates: streaming chat + function-calls to a mock case API, and structured JSON output parsing? Keep examples minimal — focus on idempotent function-calls and schema validation.
2) Aditya: please produce a quick estimate for runtime profile: candidate model variants (quantized), expected p95 latency on Redwood Dedicated (1 GPU) for 512 token context, and rough cost per 1k queries for both streaming and rerank flows.
3) Laura (me): I’ll coordinate schedule and share the HubSpot deal link; also request Thermafuse send the S3 access and any compliance checklist.

Notes to include in SDK sample:
- Function-call contract: {"name": "upsert_case", "arguments": {"case_id": "string", "summary": "string", "priority": "string"}} — must return a 200 with updated case JSON.
- Streaming policy: we should include a token limit policy and a partial-result fallback if the function-call fails (return last stable JSON and a suggested retry).
- Rerank: client sends top-N from similarity index (external vector DB) and Redwood returns score + reordering. Provide a sample scoring threshold and an opt-in caching key.

Deliverables before tech call (by Monday EOD): SDK sample repo link, initial runtime estimate spreadsheet, and a concise POC acceptance criteria doc (3 bullets: latency, basic accuracy for top-5 rerank, deterministic JSON output with schema validation).

I’ll tentatively book a 60-min slot for Tue Feb 15 09:00–10:00 PT, but will wait for Priya/Samir to confirm.

—
Laura
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@thermafuse.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@thermafuse.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: Thermafuse integration scope, SDK function-calls & POC roadmap

Thanks — quick technical confirmation and proposed resourcing: 

- Agreed on the function-call contract Laura suggested. We’ll implement a small adapter in the SDK that validates schema before sending to Thermafuse sandbox.
- POC plan: 2 devs (Redwood) full-time weeks 1–3 for SDK + integration, 1 eng week for perf tuning weeks 4–5, and 0.5 week for final acceptance and docs. I attached a resource/estimate worksheet.
- Model choices: start with a 7B quantized variant for latency targets; fall back to 13B for quality if needed. We’ll provide p50/p95 numbers for both.
- Rerank path: Redwood will accept top-50 candidates from their vector DB. We’ll run a lightweight neural reranker and return scores + reordered list. Caching: propose 1-hour TTL for query-level caching.

Links: HubSpot deal — https://app.hubspot.com/deal/123456789/THERMA-5382
Attachment: POC_resourcing.xlsx

Next steps (today)
- Aditya: produce runtime estimates and a short README for the SDK sample.
- Laura: confirm tech call time with Priya & Samir.

Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199
